user_story: As a user, I want to filter tasks by category so that I can focus on a specific area.

positive.title: Filter tasks by a valid category
steps: Select a valid category from the filter dropdown.
positive.expected_result: The tasks displayed are only those belonging to the selected category.

negative.title: Attempt to filter tasks by an invalid category
steps: Select an invalid category from the filter dropdown.
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the category is invalid and no tasks are displayed.

edge.title: Filter tasks with no categories available
steps: Ensure there are no categories available in the filter dropdown.
Attempt to click the apply filter button.
edge.expected_result: A message is displayed indicating that there are no categories to filter by, and default tasks are shown.
